E3413

Fetch: sha256 mismatch for `{url}`.

What

Fetch: sha256 mismatch for `{url}`.

Why

The downloaded content does not hash to the expected `sha256:` value. The pin ensures every machine gets byte-identical content; a mismatch means the URL content changed or the pin is wrong.

Fix

Update the `sha256:` argument to match the actual content hash shown in the Why line, or verify the URL points to the correct file.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3413: tests/ui/comptime_net_fetch_bad_hash.stderr.

Error [E3413]: fetch: sha256 mismatch for `file:///dev/null`
  --> tests/ui/comptime_net_fetch_bad_hash.jet:3:14
    |
  3 | @data :: net.fetch("file:///dev/null", sha256: "deadbeef")
    |              ^^^^^
 Why: expected `deadbeef` but content hashes to `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`
 Fix: update the `sha256:` pin to match the content, or verify the URL is correct
